concerns.text: The plan specifies a block‑permutation test with 10 000 permutations for each of the 30 composition‑index‑lag pairs (and repeats for validation and optional storm‑filtered analyses). Running ~900 000 permutations on ~200 k‑row time series is unlikely to complete within the claimed ≤ 6 h runtime on the GitHub Actions free‑tier (2 CPU cores, limited RAM). This makes the compute budget infeasible under llmXive’s free‑compute constraints. Reduce the number of permutations, use an analytical approximation, or provide a more realistic runtime estimate.
